description: Classify a confirmation message as submitted, pending, reserved or completed from caller or default phrases — Reads a confirmation page, email or API message and decides which state it states: submitted, pending, reserved or completed, using phrase lists the caller supplies (preferred, because wording is provider-specific) plus an optional default English list. Matches are whole-word, case- and typography-insensitive, returned with offsets in UTF-16, code points, UTF-8 bytes and graphemes, and a match ins

precedence.description: When several states match, the first one listed wins. Without it a conflict is unknown.

rules.description: Caller phrase lists; with these present the defaults are off unless useDefaults is true.

useDefaults.description: Include the default English phrases. Default true only when rules is absent.

name: confirmation-state
